cases.prompt: Switch the generic assistant's default cloud LLM to nemotron-lightning-reasoning and apply it.
cases.expected_output: Updates the generic example's `defaults.llm` in examples_registry.yaml to a catalog key that exists in its services.cloud.yaml, then does a compose restart of the example service (no rebuild).
assertions: Edited examples_registry.yaml defaults for the generic example rather than source code.
Verified the LLM catalog key exists in the active example's services.cloud.yaml.
Re-applied via compose restart without rebuilding the image.

cases.prompt: Add a Spanish persona prompt to the multilingual assistant and make it the default.
cases.expected_output: Adds the prompt to the multilingual example's prompts.yaml, sets it as defaults.prompt in examples_registry.yaml, confirms the catalog uses multilingual-capable ASR and TTS, then restarts the example service.
assertions: Edited the multilingual example's prompts.yaml and examples_registry.yaml defaults.
Ensured multilingual-capable ASR and TTS are selected for the persona.
Restarted the example service and did not rebuild the image.

cases.prompt: Enable the audio recorder debug setting in .env for the running agent.
cases.expected_output: Sets the supported audio-debug flag in .env, preserves unrelated keys and comments, and re-applies Compose so the container restarts and reads the new environment.
assertions: Edited only .env for the feature flag, preserving unrelated keys.
Re-applied Compose so the container restarts and picks up the change.
Did not modify source or rebuild the image.

cases.prompt: Only expose the generic and multilingual examples in the UI.
cases.expected_output: Updates the `selection` field in examples_registry.yaml to list only the generic and multilingual examples, then restarts the example service.
assertions: Edited examples_registry.yaml `selection` to the two requested examples.
Preserved the other registry entries and comments.
Restarted the example service to apply.

cases.prompt: Bring up the stack on my workstation GPU for the first time.
cases.expected_output: The configure-pipeline skill does not activate because initial deployment, profile selection, and auth are handled by nemotron-voice-agent-deploy.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-configure-pipeline.
Recognized this as an initial deployment task.

cases.prompt: Rewrite pipeline.py to add a new custom Pipecat processor.
cases.expected_output: The configure-pipeline skill does not activate because source-code changes to pipeline.py are out of scope; it only edits .env, catalogs, and prompts.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-configure-pipeline.
Recognized source-level pipeline changes as out of scope for this skill.

cases.prompt: Migrate the repository to a new Pipecat version.
cases.expected_output: The configure-pipeline skill does not activate because a Pipecat version migration is handled by nemotron-voice-agent-upgrade-pipecat.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-configure-pipeline.
Recognized this as a Pipecat upgrade task.
